parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating metal cover of the USB flash drive, made of aluminum for durability and protection.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the USB connector when not in use and rotates to expose the connector for plugging into a port.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around a pivot point to open or close over the USB connector.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of ABS plastic, housing the memory chip and connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electronic components and provides the structure for the USB connector and rotating cover.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the base for the rotating cover.
